blindSpots: Only 30 scores across 340 films. The profile knows what you love and almost nothing about what you actively dislike — The Batman is still the only real negative. Twenty more ratings, especially bad ones, would sharpen this more than anything else here.

Non-English cinema is thin — Parasite, Oldboy, City of God, Dogtooth, Spirited Away, and the two Bergmans. Not a stated dislike, just unexplored. The two Koreans at the top of Watch next are the cheapest way in.
